content.content:
## Panel

It has no header: its contents start at its top edge, on the theme's base surface.
It shows no count of what it lists.
It fills the height its sidebar's other panels leave.
Its contents scroll on their own when they are taller than it, with a permanent scrollbar along its right, as the Scrollbar says.

## Pitch
## Look

The panel's top row, the branch, is its header: 32 pixels tall, on the ribbon's tab row colour, #333333 in dark mode. Beneath it, the panel's body is on the ribbon's command area colour, #222222 in dark mode, with 8 pixels of padding at either side and at the bottom, and 4 pixels between one thing and the next. There is no line between the header and the body, nor between the file tree and the header: the change of colour is the edge. The header has, along its bottom, the 1 pixel border in the body's colour, #222222 in dark mode, that every panel header has, as the [Sidebar](../sidebar/index.md#sidebar) says. Every box and button in it is square, with no rounded corners and no border, and the Pull and Push buttons are square too.

## Sizing
26:- [GitPanel](../git-panel/index.md#git-panel)
49:- Git, a branch icon, Ctrl+Shift+G (Cmd+Shift+G on macOS), with a small badge on its icon counting the files changed and not yet committed, in the theme's accent, left out at none
57:- Git: the GitPanel alone, filling the view, its changes list taking the height the git panel's own sections leave, no longer squeezed beneath the file tree
60:The Git panel and the file tree no longer share a view: the edge that was dragged between them is gone, and each view has the whole height. Everything else about each panel stays as its own spec says.

content.text:
The git panel now fills the whole height of the left sidebar's Git view, from beneath the ribbon to the window's bottom, however few notes it has.

- **Top:** the branch with Pull and Push, then the summary.
- **Bottom:** the message box, Generate and Commit.
- **Between:** the commit notes fill the space and scroll within it. With few notes or none, that space is just left empty in the panel's background colour.

One existing test expected the message box to sit right under the last note, so I changed it to expect empty space in between. I also added a check that the panel fills its full height and keeps Commit at the bottom. All git panel and main window tests pass.

The spec and your prompt agree here.
